english.title: Falsify / conceal / destroy / dispose of a document relevant to a Part XI investigation
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), knowing that an investigation was being or was likely to be conducted under Part XI of the Financial Services and Markets Act 2000,

(A)_[falsified]_
(B)_[concealed]_
(C)_[destroyed]_
(D)_[disposed of]_

a document, namely **(..SPECIFY THE DOCUMENT..), which you knew or suspected was or would have been relevant to such an investigation
english.legislation: Contrary to section 177(3)(a) and (5) of the Financial Services and Markets Act 2000.

investigatoraction.description: DNA Samples: If crime scene stain present - take evidential sample If no crime scene stain and DNA not confirmed on PNC - take Criminal Justice sample. If DNA confirmed on PNC - CJ sample not required
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes:
(i) In proceedings for an offence under this section it is a defence for the accused to show that he had no intention of concealing facts disclosed by the document from the investigator
(ii) Section 401 of the Financial Services and Markets Act 2000 provides that proceedings for offences may be instituted in England and Wales only by the 'appropriate regulator' (either the Financial Conduct or the Prudential Regulation Authority) or the Secretary of State or by or with the consent of the Director of Public Prosecutions.

other.penalty:
Summary: Six months imprisonment and / or a fine not exceeding the statutory maximum.
Indictment: Two years imprisonment and / or a fine.

Time limit for prosecutions:
None

On the 12th March 2015 the limit on fines imposed by a Magistrates’ court was removed – as such, the potential fine on summary conviction in relation to an offence committed after this date is unlimited.
